steps.en: Prepare Python, browser and Poppler; correct the builder's data-directory reference
steps.zh: 准备运行环境，修正生成器的数据目录引用

steps.en: Start the documented report rebuild from the repository root
steps.zh: 在仓库根目录启动文档中的重建命令
steps.code: python3 render.py build.py 报告.html 报告.pdf

steps.en: Assemble the report HTML with evidence IDs and inline SVG charts
steps.zh: 组装带证据编号和内联图表的报告网页

steps.en: Print PDF and patch chapter page numbers, for up to four rounds
steps.zh: 打印 PDF 并回填章页码，最多四轮

steps.en: Keep the PDF and print text/margin diagnostics for your review
steps.zh: 保留 PDF，打印文本及留白问题供你复核

value.en: Reuse a case-specific report build and page diagnostics instead of hand-numbering its contents
value.zh: 复用个案报告生成及页面诊断，不必手填目录页码
